strategies.name: Shrunk team efficiency spread
strategies.hypothesis: Estimate opponent-adjusted offense/defense and home/neutral effects; regress unstable conversion and turnover components.
strategies.required_inputs: Team game scores and pregame features, long official history.
strategies.source_scope: Official definitions/data context, not endorsement or verified predictive edge.

strategies.name: Pace × efficiency total
strategies.hypothesis: Drive count and scoring distributions; separate weather, venue and overtime regimes.
strategies.required_inputs: Official play/drive history, timestamps, forecasts available at cutoff.
strategies.source_scope: Official definitions/data context, not endorsement or verified predictive edge.

strategies.name: Calibrated moneyline
strategies.hypothesis: Fit joint score distribution; sum win/tie probabilities, use actual settlement rules.
strategies.required_inputs: Out-of-sample score distributions, observed primary quotes.
strategies.source_scope: Official definitions/data context, not endorsement or verified predictive edge.

strategies.name: NGS completion residual
strategies.hypothesis: Shrink completion above expectation; test incremental held-out proper-score improvement, not raw season record.
strategies.required_inputs: Official game-level xCOMP, attempts, availability and exposure.
strategies.source_scope: Official definitions/data context, not endorsement or verified predictive edge.

strategies.name: QB passing workload
strategies.hypothesis: Model dropbacks → attempts → completions → yardage; account for sacks, injury and role uncertainty.
strategies.required_inputs: Official player-game workload and primary prop history.
strategies.source_scope: Official definitions/data context, not endorsement or verified predictive edge.

strategies.name: Receiver target-share shrinkage
strategies.hypothesis: Hierarchical route/target shares and distribution of depth/YAC; avoid top-25 survivor sample.
strategies.required_inputs: Complete player-game targets, routes and role histories.
strategies.source_scope: Official definitions/data context, not endorsement or verified predictive edge.

strategies.name: RB rushing role model
strategies.hypothesis: Carries × yards distribution with game-script uncertainty and correlated volume.
strategies.required_inputs: Official carries, participation, injury reports and primary quotes.
strategies.source_scope: Official definitions/data context, not endorsement or verified predictive edge.

strategies.name: Cross-game pair
strategies.hypothesis: Join calibrated joint outcomes, test shared-week/team factors; never assume independence because games differ.
strategies.required_inputs: Synchronized primary leg quotes, payouts and outcomes.
strategies.source_scope: Official definitions/data context, not endorsement or verified predictive edge.

strategies.name: Side + total
strategies.hypothesis: Simulate joint home/away scores; evaluate cover/over indicators at actual quoted thresholds.
strategies.required_inputs: Calibrated joint score distribution and primary SGP payouts.
strategies.source_scope: Official definitions/data context, not endorsement or verified predictive edge.

strategies.name: QB + receiver overs
strategies.hypothesis: Shared play-level opportunities and yardage allocation; evaluate joint exceedance, not raw-yard correlation.
strategies.required_inputs: Matched player-game observations and primary combo payout.
strategies.source_scope: Official definitions/data context, not endorsement or verified predictive edge.

strategies.name: RB + receiver / opponent pair
strategies.hypothesis: Model pace and game-script mixtures, test injury scenarios and joint-tail risk.
strategies.required_inputs: Complete matched player-game observations and exact settlement rules.
strategies.source_scope: Official definitions/data context, not endorsement or verified predictive edge.
